mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS review_id, r.place_id, re.embedding, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN review_embeddings re ON re.review_id = r.id WHERE r.user_id <> #{userId} AND re.embedder_version = #{embedderVersion} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM likes l WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.review_id = r.id ) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
